scientific_reframing: Which interacting functions of sleep—homeostatic recovery, circadian timing, memory processing, brain-clearance physiology, immune regulation, and whole-body repair—are causally necessary for specific cognitive and physiological outcomes, and how do their effects depend on sleep stage, timing, prior wake, and individual state?
human_review_items: Review sleep restriction safety, exclusion rules, stop rules, and recovery access before execution.
Review consent, privacy, and governance for longitudinal wearable, neural, immune, and physiological data.
Review immune, clearance-related, and sleep-stage measurement validity and causal mediation assumptions.
Review statistical power, crossover carryover, practice, illness, medication, and individual-response calibration.
